decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper builds directly on the firm's established construction machinery knowledge and still has its own page, so the firm can interpret results and refine it.
The articulated dumper is a close extension of the firm's core offer, is still presented on its own page, and is supported by in-house R&D.

The mine rescue vehicle lies far from the core offer and was downgraded to a mere mention in 2024, which signals weak assimilation, but the firm's underground vehicle expertise and own R&D still make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
The compact telescopic loader builds on the firm's lifting and construction experience and remains prominently presented.
The material lift is close to the established offer and is reported as the most popular rental lift with a large current order, giving clear positive evidence.

Although the underground loader is more distant from the core offer, its quantified field results (1,000 operating hours in 7 months) and dedicated page show the firm is learning from it successfully.
